action_semantics.sampled_rng: global MPS generator reseeded once per registered controller group
action_semantics.evaluation: normal start; difficulty 2; patterns and powerups enabled; cap 18000; no cutoff

statistic: Q1 is mean survival in the worst 25 percent of pooled complete games; sampled uses bottom 192 of 768 and argmax bottom 64 of 256.
uncertainty: 2000 percentile bootstrap draws resample shared game-seed clusters and retain all three sampled controller repetitions within each cluster.
limits: Exact limits and eight-group order come from pinned parent protocol.json.
